note: Fiji, read on the Ministry of Immigration's own pages (immigration.gov.fj, under the Immigration Act 2003) on 2026-10-30. A long-term work permit is for employment with a locally registered company, valid one to three years (3 kept, the longest grant), lodged online through IMMI HUB; a first-time applicant must be outside Fiji (abroad), except a spouse of a Fiji citizen; an extension of a work permit is on the fee list (renewable). A short-term work permit (section 9(2)(c)) is for expertise urgently needed, one year or less, applied for by one holding a business visitor's permit or from outside (either). Each costs the FJ$650.05 application fee and the FJ$185.00 permit issue fee, kept together as FJ$835.05; a security bond may also be asked, which the form doesn't hold. Both are for the employment contracted (work for the sponsor). An entertainer's shorter stay is the authority to work on a visitor's permit (the work engine's route), not a residence. No decision time is promised (one may follow up after 30 working days). Permanent residence and naturalisation's years aren't on the pages read and aren't kept.

sources.title: Ministry of Immigration, Fiji: Long Term Work Permit
sources.said: The new long term work permit refers to an employment in a locally registered company that is for the duration of one (01) to three (03) years. ... First-time lodgement of a new long-term work permit, the applicant must be outside the country, except where the applicant is the spouse of a Fiji citizen ... One (01) to three (03) years

sources.title: Ministry of Immigration, Fiji: Short Term Work Permit
sources.said: A Short-Term Work Permit is granted to a person whose expertise is urgently needed in the country to work in Fiji for a period of one year or less. Authority is issued under Section 9(2)(c) of the Immigration Act, 2003. ... Applicant who holds Business Visitor Permit (14 days or 21 days) ... FJD 650.05

sources.title: Ministry of Immigration, Fiji: Forms and Fees
sources.said: Work Permit Application Received ... FJ$650.05 ... Extension of Work Permit ... Permit issue fees ... FJ$185.00

sources.title: Ministry of Immigration, Fiji: Work permits
sources.said: Your employer or sponsor in Fiji usually initiates the application. ... A security bond may be required before the permit is granted. ... You may follow up with the Ministry after 30 working days via the enquiry form.
